data.text: Before we head out, how about we agree to 10 tons each this month? That gives each of us $10,000 and leaves 50 tons to reproduce, bringing the lake back to 100 next month. It’s the largest total catch we can sustain month after month, shared equally. My family has fished here for years, and I want this lake to keep supporting all our families. We can review everyone’s catches afterward and stick with the same limits if the lake stays full. John, would you agree?
